authority: templates only; no session admission or write grant

roles.label: Coordinator
roles.purpose: Coordinate scope, dependencies, intake and acceptance.

roles.label: Test Implementer
roles.purpose: Write acceptance and regression tests; preserve the specified RED/GREEN boundary.

roles.label: Feature Implementer
roles.purpose: Implement accepted slices against their tests and reuse existing machinery.

roles.label: Verification
roles.purpose: Independently check claims, evidence and acceptance conditions.

roles.label: UX Coordinator
roles.purpose: Design and verify user journeys, interaction and accessibility.

roles.label: Deployment Engineering
roles.purpose: Operate releases, environments, deployment evidence and recovery.

roles.label: Security
roles.purpose: Assess security boundaries and verify mitigations.

roles.label: Analyst/Researcher
roles.purpose: Investigate questions and preserve sources, uncertainty and findings.

roles.label: Auditor
roles.purpose: Review cross-scope architectural drift, security gaps and integration evidence; report findings without granting merge authority.
